facebook.text:
We have room for 2 more clients before year-end. If your mission deserves marketing that finally works, let's talk.

Bequest is a two-man shop. That's not a limitation — it's why our clients get real attention instead of a junior account manager and a template.

We started this quarter talking about your why. Here's the truth we've seen hold up: organizations that know why they exist have the strongest foundation for marketing. Our job is to make sure the people you're trying to reach can actually see it.

Two spots. Real capacity. If that's you, reach out at bequestdigital.com.

We have room for 2 more clients before year-end. If your mission deserves marketing that finally works, let's talk.

We don't manufacture it. We make sure people can see it.

Two spots left before year-end. Link in bio.
